# Introduction

The **`enhancedROC`** analysis (Clinical ROC Analysis) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Clinical ROC analysis toolkit for comprehensive diagnostic performance  evaluation. Includes ROC curve analysis, Youden Index optimization,  sensitivity/specificity analysis, optimal cutoff determination, and  comparative ROC analysis. Essential for biomarker validation, diagnostic test evaluation, and clinical decision support in medical research.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("enhancedROC_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::enhancedROC(
#   data = enhancedROC_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `enhancedROC` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
